reviewText:
**I accept the bounded TAC-03 declared-geometry113 module**, with frozen source `7261052ae4dec908f8c0ac38e0a2c5f4b831065b` and [final evidence at `cd60eacd`](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/cd60eacd075b8ed4b4738fd9effed19ecf6c1237/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-16-tac03-declared-geometry-runtime/README.md). I found no remaining concrete acceptance blocker.

The two runtime corrections remain resolved. The wire112 support-path correction is present, and fresh compatibility executions complete with the corrected driver. Git shows no engine changes after the frozen source.

My independent source and artifact reconciliation covered:

- **Original run:** all1,576 unique passing cases, all six original worker identities, ordered assignments/journals, completion records, DONE markers and empty stderr. DLL hashes and recorded MVIDs reconcile across starts, completions and focused execution. All1,570 predecessors retain their authenticated order and shard assignments.
- **Connected execution:**115 canonical,345 filtered-view and5,520 public-behavior comparisons match across the five paths. After-probe saves remain unchanged. All23 reference checkpoints match the genuine C# evidence.
- **Focused parity:** all130 artifacts match the full run, with exact counts97/1/10/22/0/0. Both zero-file controls have explicit passing results and substantive in-memory assertions. The collector correction does not conceal skipped execution.
- **Compatibility and persistence:** authentic95–112 continuations and old views reconcile, as do all62 unchanged-state profile rejections, six hostile inputs and five backup/recovery controls.
- **Bindings:** every member of the8,502-member final archive and1,326-member supplemental archive rehashed successfully. Preserved correction archives,131 historical pins,457 compilation inputs,955 static inputs and127 consumer rows across100 files reconcile. Executed host/driver bindings match retained source bytes.

The genuine route supports the required paid movement, Difficult/Severe costs, fractional positions, discovered tactical command, OA/armed Press/nested response, actual Dead closure and continued play. Mechanical channel probes and excluded procedures retain their documented limits.

**Verification limits:** I performed read-only source inspection and independent Python/Git/JSON/byte/hash checks. I did not compile C#, execute gameplay or PowerShell qualification, restore saves through the engine, rerun the full suite, or observe live workers. Those executions remain Codex’s retained evidence.

The immediate next gate is **the amended complete TAC-10 Undead source/API contract**, using this qualified geometry capability. Preserve **TAC-03 ← CHR-01/TAC-01** and **TAC-10 ← TAC-03/TAC-04/TAC-05/TAC-02**. This accepts the selected geometry slice; it neither completes every prerequisite node nor authorizes creature or Consecration runtime.

Whole-engine completion, broader P1 and production authority remain open. Unity remains deferred; storage cleanup and GitHub Support remain held.
